messages:
Maria (CS): Heads-up — Equinox legal sent an updated DPA + SOC2 questionnaire they need answers for by EOD tomorrow. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/dpas/equinox-dpa-draft Please review key items: data residency, subprocessors, logs retention, and breach notification. Attaching file.

Jess (Security): Thanks. Can you drop the doc here? I'll prioritize. Key Qs: do they require SOC2 Type II report copy and do they want 3rd-party subprocessors list? Also what's their expected retention period?

Maria (CS): Uploaded: https://storage.redwood.ai/attachments/eq_dpa_v3.pdf. They ask for 'subprocessors list + flow diagram' and 90-day retention for debug logs.

Tom G.: For SSO -> we can confirm SAML support. For logs: we store full request logs 90 days in prod by default, but PII redaction happens at ingest. Need to confirm exact fields.

Jess (Security): 90 days is fine technically. Need legal to sign subproc addendum. Proposed answers (draft):

```
data_residency: "US and EU regions available; customer can request EU-only tenancy for Private deployments."
soc2: "Redwood maintains SOC2 Type II; report available under NDA."
subprocessors: "See public list https://status.redwood.ai/subprocessors; we can provide a current export on request."
logs_retention: "90 days (debug), 7 days (request-level metrics aggregated). PII redaction applied per policy."
breach_notify: "72-hour initial notification + remediation plan."
```

Sam (Platform): I'll export current subproc list and last SOC2 report to a secure share. @Jess (Security) do you want me to redact anything before share?

Jess (Security): Yes — redact internal IPs and customer identifiers. Also attach the control matrix mapping.

Equinox Legal: Thanks — a few clarifications: 1) For 'EU-only tenancy' we need contract language guaranteeing no cross-border replication, 2) an SLA for data access during incident. Can Redwood commit?

Maria (CS): @Equinox Legal we can offer EU-only tenancy on Private or Dedicated. For Hosted we can offer data residency + contractual clause that logs are stored in EU and not replicated. SLA for access — we have standard response SLAs; ops can confirm.

Tom G.: For hosted, we need to ensure S3 buckets and backups are region-specific. Ops: we can add contract wording: 'no cross-border replication without customer consent'.

Jess (Security): I'll draft concise answers and flag two items for legal: subproc addendum and explicit non-replication clause. Assuming we get their NDA, I'll send SOC2 report.

Maria (CS): Timeline: goal to send draft answers by 10:30am PT tomorrow. @Sam @Tom can you have the subproc export + region config by 9am?

Sam (Platform): Yep can do. :+1:

Tom G.: Will confirm SSO and backup regs by 9am. Also noticed they asked about KMS/HSM. We support customer-managed KMS in Private; Hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS with rotation logs.

Jess (Security): Add KMS answer to the draft.

Maria (CS): Thanks all. I'll collate and send to Equinox Legal once Jess approves. :raised_hands:

Equinox Legal: Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll review draft once received.
